seed.tagline: Turn the Notion databases a team runs on into a rulebook you own.
seed.description: Extracts Notion databases -- properties, relations, rollups, formulas and pages -- into a rulebook, then derives everything from it: the Postgres schema, documentation, RuleSpeak, the explainer DAG, an Excel workbook and the browser rulebook editor. Re-pull it with effortless build -id and the rulebook follows the workspace.
seed.requiresInput: Notion databases shared with an integration, and its token

replacements.label: What should we call it?
replacements.description: Short lower-case project name (becomes the repository and database name)

replacements.label: Notion integration token
replacements.description: An internal integration token; share the databases you want with that integration. Used once for the extraction and not stored.

replacements.label: Which databases?
replacements.description: Blank means every database shared with the integration.
